scenario.description: An S-4 logistics officer must publish the next workday receiving and staging plan for four inbound sustainment consignments, setting exact receiving locations, time windows, release controls, and access coordination actions.

shared_context.S1: Four sustainment consignments are expected at the support compound next workday: battery pallets, engine-oil drums, vehicle HVAC parts, and calibration test equipment.
shared_context.S2: The warehouse has Dock 1, Dock 2, a Spill Bay, and the South Yard available for receiving and staging.
shared_context.S3: Maj. Okafor publishes the receiving board and may assign locations, time windows, release controls, and coordination actions.
shared_context.S4: The normal receiving process records an arrival window, staging location, inspection status, and any access or transport coordination requirement for each consignment.
shared_context.S5: At the routine 0700 logistics huddle, the S-4 officer reviews the receiving board with supply, maintenance, transportation, and security before issuing the final board.

PF1.text: The battery carrier confirmed an appointment for exactly 0800-0900 next workday and requires Dock 2 for unloading; SFC Bell received the carrier confirmation this morning, but the appointment has not yet been entered on the warehouse board.

PF2.text: The engine-oil drums must be staged in the Spill Bay and held for sampling until exactly 1600 next workday before release; CW2 Ramirez recorded the laboratory requirement after this morning's maintenance review, but the receiving clerk has not received the updated handling note.

PF3.text: The vehicle HVAC-parts flatbed will arrive exactly 1300-1400 next workday and must unload in the South Yard because the planned approach to Dock 1 is unavailable to that vehicle; Lt. Haddad received the carrier's route update this afternoon, but the revised arrival notice has not been posted.

PF4.text: The calibration test equipment is controlled property and requires a security escort during receipt and placement in Cage 3; SSG Mercer confirmed the property-control instruction with the access desk today, but the escort requirement is not yet on the receiving board.

acceptance_conditions: The battery pallets must be assigned to Dock 2 for the 0800-0900 window.
The engine-oil drums must be staged in the Spill Bay and released at exactly 1600.
The vehicle HVAC parts must be assigned to the South Yard for the 1300-1400 window.
The calibration test equipment must be placed in Cage 3 with a security escort.
The receiving board must include a battery carrier coordination action.
The receiving board must include an oil sampling hold action.
The receiving board must include an HVAC flatbed coordination action.
The calibration equipment control fact must be cited in the justification.

content_checks.C8: any(('battery carrier' in c['detail'] or 'carrier' in c['detail']) for c in commitments) and any(('sampling' in c['detail'] or 'Spill Bay' in c['detail'] or 'handling note' in c['detail']) for c in commitments) and any(('flatbed' in c['detail'] or 'South Yard' in c['detail'] or 'arrival notice' in c['detail']) for c in commitments)

decisive_facts.why: The carrier confirmation changes the battery assignment to Dock 2, fixes its receiving window at exactly 0800-0900, and requires the battery-carrier coordination action.
The laboratory handling requirement changes the oil staging location to Spill Bay, fixes release at exactly 1600, and requires the oil-sampling hold action.
The route update changes the HVAC-parts location to South Yard, fixes the arrival window at exactly 1300-1400, and requires the flatbed coordination action.
The property-control instruction changes calibration-equipment storage to Cage 3, requires a security escort, and supplies the fact that must be cited.
